risks.title: Library staff change booking rules
risks.cause: Booking rules are set by a library committee that meets monthly
risks.event: The committee changes slot lengths after the API is built
risks.response: Get the committee to sign off the booking rules before T05 starts

risks.title: College server not ready
risks.cause: The college IT team handles deployments on request
risks.response: Raise the access request in week 1 and keep a free cloud tier as fallback

risks.title: Concurrency bugs in seat locking
risks.cause: Many students book the same slots at 8 am
risks.response: Use database row locks and add a load test of 200 parallel bookings
